text: Si heɓii on -ko onon yo sirkooɓe- jarrabuyee e huunde aññiinde ka maayo haa tawa on hulii halkaaree, wirnoto ka miijo mon kon ko laatino ɗon hiɗon rewa ko woori Alla, on jantotaako si wanah Alla ɗaɓɓiron Mo faabo, tuma nde O faabii on O hisini on immorde e ko hulunoɗon kon, wontuɗon ka njorndi ɗurnoɗon e ngootimbaaku Makko e noddugol Mo Kanko tun, ruttoɗon e sanamuuji mon, neɗɗanke on laatike ko o heewuɗo yeddugol neemaaji Alla ɗin.
